description: Cyklostezky is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Ostrava. Layer of cycle paths - broken down by type, route and surface quality. Type - separate, common path for pedestrians and cyclists, route led on purpose-built, public, along traffic calmed road or pedestrian zone, lane on the road, with lanes for pedestrians and cyclists. Coverage: Statutární město Ostrava. The portal shows the English title as "Cycle paths" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Ostrava. Its keywords include doprava, cyklostezka, stezka, okres Ostrava - město, cyklo, Ostrava. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00845451/d861c268589f220f99631f14ce1c6c03/distribuce/f8e2b377e26aba370cd0461b08ae3501/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
